implementation_guidance: Utilize the standard system process creation API provided by the runtime environment.
Separate the executable name from its parameter slice before invoking the process launcher.

hints.content: Operating systems maintain a distinction between the current program and external binaries stored on disk. To run an external program, the parent application must issue a system request specifying the target executable along with any configuration parameters.
Look for standard runtime library functions dedicated to command execution. You will want to pass your first token as the command identifier and any subsequent tokens as the argument parameters.
